title: Capgemini style · Pseudocode, English, Quant
description: Pseudocode-heavy pattern with English and quant. 70 MCQs in 75 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text:
What is the output of this pseudocode?

s = 0
for i = 5 to 9 step 2
    s = s + i
end for
print s
questions.explanation: The loop takes i = 5, 7, 9; the result is 21.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

A good resume is short and specific. Recruiters spend less than a minute on a first look, so the most important facts must be easy to find. Instead of listing duties, strong resumes show results with numbers, such as ‘reduced page load time by 40%’. Spelling mistakes and long paragraphs create a poor impression.

What creates a poor impression?
questions.explanation: The passage supports: Spelling mistakes.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: He has a ____ knowledge of finance.
questions.explanation: Correct: He has a thorough knowledge of finance.

questions.text:
Spot the part of the sentence that has an error:
(A) The book (B) which I bought (C) yesterday (D) is very interesting.
questions.explanation: The sentence is correct.

questions.text: Choose the best replacement for the part in brackets: She [suggested him to take] a break.
questions.explanation: Correct: She suggested that he take a break.

questions.text:
Arrange the sentences in the correct order:
P: The team missed the project deadline.
Q: The team now confirms requirements before starting.
R: The leader called a meeting to find the cause.
S: Unclear requirements had led to rework.
questions.explanation: Correct order: The team missed the project deadline. The leader called a meeting to find the cause. Unclear requirements had led to rework. The team now confirms requirements before starting.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

Plastic is cheap, light and durable, which is why it is everywhere. The same durability makes it a problem: most plastic takes hundreds of years to break down. Much of it ends up in rivers and oceans, where it harms animals that swallow it or get trapped. Recycling helps, but only a small share of plastic is actually recycled. Experts say the most effective step is to use less plastic in the first place.

What does the passage say about recycling?
options: It is banned in most places
Only a small share of plastic is recycled
questions.explanation: The passage supports: Only a small share of plastic is recycled.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: I prefer tea ____ coffee.
questions.explanation: Correct: I prefer tea to coffee.

questions.text:
Spot the part of the sentence that has an error:
(A) The news (B) are (C) too good (D) to be true.
questions.explanation: ‘News’ is singular: ‘is’.

questions.text: Choose the best replacement for the part in brackets: The reason he failed [is because] he was lazy.
questions.explanation: Correct: The reason he failed is that he was lazy.

questions.text:
Arrange the sentences in the correct order:
P: The vapour rises and cools in the air.
Q: Water evaporates from oceans and lakes.
R: When the droplets grow heavy, they fall as rain.
S: It condenses into tiny droplets that form clouds.
questions.explanation: Correct order: Water evaporates from oceans and lakes. The vapour rises and cools in the air. It condenses into tiny droplets that form clouds. When the droplets grow heavy, they fall as rain.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

Electric vehicles are becoming more common in Indian cities. They produce no exhaust and are cheaper to run than petrol vehicles. Their main drawbacks are a higher purchase price and a shortage of charging stations. As battery prices fall and more chargers are installed, experts expect electric two-wheelers and buses to spread fastest.

What will help electric vehicles spread?
options: Falling battery prices and more chargers
questions.explanation: The passage supports: Falling battery prices and more chargers.

questions.text:
Read the passage and answer.

Open-source software is written by communities and shared freely. Anyone can read the code, suggest changes or report bugs. Because many people review it, problems are often found quickly. Companies use open-source tools to save costs and avoid being locked to one vendor, and many pay their engineers to contribute back.

Why are problems often found quickly?
questions.explanation: The passage supports: Many people review the code.

questions.text: A can do a job in 10 days and B in 5 days. They work together for 3 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the job?
questions.explanation: In 3 days they do 9/10 of the work; 1/10 is left, which A does in 1/10 × 10 = 1 days.

questions.text: A sum of money amounts to Rs 13200 in 4 years at 5% per annum simple interest. What is the sum?
Two trains of lengths 150 m and 300 m run at 36 km/h and 45 km/h in opposite directions. How long do they take to cross each other completely?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 81 km/h = 45/2 m/s; distance = 450 m; time = 20 s.

questions.text: A trader marks his goods 50% above the cost price and then allows a discount of 25%. What is his gain or loss percent?
questions.explanation: SP as a fraction of CP = 3/2 × 3/4 = 9/8, so 25/2% gain.

questions.text: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 30 and 8 hours. Pipe C can empty it in 40 hours. If all three are opened together, how long will the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/30 + 1/8 − 1/40 = 2/15 tank/hour, so 15/2 hours.

questions.text: The average age of 12 students is 28 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average decreases by 2 years. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: New total = 26 × 13 = 338; old total = 336; teacher = 2.

questions.text: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 4:3. After 8 years, the ratio will be 36:29. What is A's present age?
questions.explanation: Let ages be 4x and 3x. (4x+8)/(3x+8) = 36/29 gives x = 7; A = 28.

questions.text: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 30 and 20 hours. Pipe C can empty it in 60 hours. If all three are opened together, how long will the tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/30 + 1/20 − 1/60 = 1/15 tank/hour, so 15 hours.
